description: Set a layer's Blending Options (Layer Style dialog): blend mode, opacity and fill opacity; Advanced Blending knockout, the channels it blends into and the group options (Blend Interior Effects as Group, Blend Clipped Layers as Group, Transparency Shapes Layer, Layer Mask Hides Effects, Vector Mask Hides Effects); and Blend If ranges for this layer and the underlying layer

blendIf.description: Blend If, one entry per channel: { channel: "gray" or a colour channel, thisLayer: [black, black split, white split, white], underlyingLayer: [...] }, levels 0-255

channels.description: Channels the layer blends into, e.g. ["red", "blue"]; the document's own channel names

fillOpacity.description: Fill opacity, percent (pixel, type and shape layers)

target.description: Which layers to act on. Give ids (from list_layers or a create tool), names, or active: true

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)

name: set_blending_options
title: Set Blending Options
